measurement_basis: authenticated campaign activity, source inspection, and bounded verification

observation.source_interface: MNCS Environment and Control campaign interfaces

outcome.implementation_change: Control accepts an exact campaign-writable-checkout marker supplied by a bridge that requires a nonempty approval_reference. It still verifies the checkout and does not extend the campaign's writable repository set.
outcome.analysis_limit: The source and focused tests are verified, but the live Environment bridge still returns an error or authority denial and has not demonstrated the same-campaign checkout binding end to end.

related_work.work_intent_goal: exercise canonical Environment persistence through the Control socket
related_work.campaign_objective: MNCS Environmental Capability Intelligence and Continuous Improvement, including capability accountability and machine-native adoption

improvement_relation.basis: Control now accepts the exact session-bound checkout selector when the same repository is already writable, while preserving exact owner approval for additional repositories. Regression tests verified acceptance and rejection boundaries. The connected service has not yet run the new path.
not_measured: live Environment operation success after service adoption
